main_text.l: In vocatione {Electione ipsorum. Luc,24.45 specialia sunt de Ordinatione ipsorū. 46. 47. 48 49.50.Ioa.20.21.22.Rom.1.2.3.
main_text.p: In electione ipsorum speciale fuit, quod Christi ipsis vili voce αμέσος & quasi ipsius χειροτονία derunt designati. Mat.28.18.19. Act.1. 23.24. & 26. ó6.1.Cor.9.1.Gal.1.1.
In ipsorum ordinatione speciale sunt,quod modo à Christo immediatè designato in munus sint asciti & separati. Ioa.20.21.Act.8.17.Rom.1.1.

Ad confirmationem autem pertinebat quod omnibus (a) prædictis donis & futura prædicendi facultate, quam accumulatissimè prædiri fuerunt, ita vt in quaq; ministerij parte spiritus pleno afflatu & motu sine errore & labe omni sint gubernati. (a) Ioan.20. 21.22.Marc, 16.15.16.17. Ioan.16.13. 2. Thess.3.1.2.3.&c. (b) Ioan. 16.8.9.10.11.12. 13.14. Act.1.4.5.6.7. Act.10.18.19.20. 21.22. & 13.1.& 16.7. 9.10.11.& 20.22.24.25.
Atq; hæc de Apostolis, qui fuerunt {Duodeei primò, Gal. 2.1. 2.3. 4.5. 1.Cor.8.1.2.3. 1. Afciti postea. Cor.11.5.}
Duodecim,sunt illi qui à Christo adhuc in tertiis versante designati sunt. Ibid. Mat. 28. Marc. 16.Act.

page.notes: Right margin note: "De Apo. specibus cap.18." (rendered as "De Apo. spe ecie bus cap.18."). Section marks and the diagram braces are approximated; the diagram lines are partly illegible. Several Greek words (αμέσος, χειροτονία) are transcribed as read and may be imprecise. The bottom "16.Act" and "Bb4" are signature and catchword elements rather than body text.
